race.description: Junee Prime Lamb Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: TO DUBAI WE GO (14) brings the strongest overall form reference, with her Rosehill return better than seventh suggests after beginning awkwardly and striking interference before chipping away. She is eased from mid-week company, has prior Listed Fernhill Handicap experience and gets a 1.5kg apprentice claim. This looks the right assignment for her to break through at start seven. INSPIRITU (9) is the immediate danger after being beaten a head at Orange first-up as favourite, and her two placings from two attempts at this distance read well for a Mdn of this depth. FIGHTING FOX (7) comes off a narrow second at this track at big odds and has enough recent substance to keep the main pair honest. DIVINE SPARK (6) resumes from a lengthy break with the five placings from her nine starts. Fitted with the one trial placing here and maps well from the low draw. Genuine contender.
